selection.motivation: After selected 8-head intervention improved wrong-history code accuracy by 8.26pp on first 345 heldout cases; use previously unused 130 structural-validation cases and same-layer controls.

gold_control.purpose: Oracle-positive history control: determine whether selected heads also help when prior diagnosis is correct; frozen before followup inference.

selection.generation_scope_addition: Before 130-case followup, after prefill-only intervention did not improve first 60-case name generation: add same frozen heads gated throughout answer decoding, plus native cached-sham checks. No head reselection.
